en.bdb: Gurmukhs have learnt the technique of life in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: chet basa(n)t sura(n)g sabh ra(n)g maaniaa|

en.bdb: They have consciously enjoyed the delight of the spring season of life.
They are elated like the water of rainy season (Savan) but still they (gurmukhs) have made water of hopes and desires go down and downward.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲੁ ਸੁ ਢੰਗ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: sajan melu su dda(n)g choj viddaaniaa|

en.bdb: Meeting with such persons is wonderfully delightful.
They way of gurmukhs is devoid of mire and is accepted in the court of the Lord.
A meeting through the wisdom of the Guru is obstruction free, true and delightful.
